name: Question Mark
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' hidden model, reachable on the module only with the marquee set to "49": a Morse transmitter keying a sine over a drifting noise bed, through a squared-distortion stage.

controls.label: Static
controls.description: The module's own COLOR: the noise bed's floor and the distortion depth together, as one knob.

controls.label: Speed
controls.description: The keying rate, from a 123 ms dit to a 37 ms one — the module's own TIMBRE.

controls.label: Bed
controls.description: The noise level on its own, from a bare keyed tone to well past the module's loudest bed.

controls.label: Grit
controls.description: The squared distortion on its own, from a clean sum to twice the module's depth.

outputs.main: The transmission, the module's own signal.
outputs.aux: Mono: the keyed carrier alone, before the bed and the distortion. Stereo: a second full transmission whose noise draws come from an independent generator, so the tone stays centred and the bed opens out.

trigger: Restarts the Morse transmission from its first symbol.
